Clause 9.47.1 - other (development_control): This section of the Development Control Plan (DCP) establishes  a framework to guide development in Pr ecinct 47 – Victoria Road (the precinct).

Clause 9.47.1 - other (development_control): This section of the DCP applies to development within the boundary of the precinct as shown in  Figure 1: Land application - Precinct 47 – Victoria Road Precinct, Marrickville.

Clause 9.47 - other (development_control): The purpose of this section of the DCP is to guide the future development of the precinct by:

Clause 9.47 - other (development_control): Communic ating the planning, design and environmental objectives and controls against which the consent authority will assess future development applications

Clause 9.47 - other (development_control): Ensuring the orderly, efficient and environmentally sensitive development of the p recinct

Clause 9.47 - other (development_control): Promoting  a high -quality urban design outcome

Clause 9.47 - other (development_control): Ensure key infrastructure is delivered for future residents and the community

Clause 9.47 - other (development_control): Ensure access within the precinct is inclusive by delivering a high quality urban/public domain which is accessible beyond a min imum compliance approach and which caters for equitable, dignified, safe and easy to use access  for all
